articles.title: A Shark That Walks? Meet the Ocean's Newest Waddling Wonder!
articles.summary: Imagine a shark that uses its fins to stroll across the seafloor like a puppy! Divers just found a brand-new walking shark in Papua New Guinea, with brown dots and white dashes. It's only the 10th walking shark ever discovered.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's Dream Festival: All Girls, All Day, All for a Good Cause!
articles.summary: Pop star Olivia Rodrigo is throwing her own music festival called Daisy Chain Fields, and the lineup is packed with amazing women like Chappell Roan and Stevie Nicks. Best part? All the money goes to charities that help girls and women.

articles.title: How Teens Invented Cool: From Drive-Ins to TikTok, It's Been a Wild Ride!
articles.summary: Did you know teenagers weren't always a thing? In the 1950s, teens suddenly had money, cars, and their own hangouts—and they've been shaping pop culture ever since. From transistor radios to malls, each generation left its mark.
